condition: dayjs.tz / .tz() conversion around a DST transition in the local (or target) timezone produces an offset off by one hour (e.g. +07:00 for Asia/Shanghai when local tz is Australia/Adelaide).
workaround: Detect the bad offset by comparing against offsets of neighbouring days and repair with dayjsDate.utcOffset(dayjsDate.utcOffset() + 60, true).
